# shyamlogistic

> Official website of shyamlogistic (SHYAM LOGISTIC) — GST-registered road logistics and freight company in Sangli, Maharashtra, India. Founder Mohanlal. Book FTL, PTL, express cargo, and pan-India transport.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/): Official shyamlogistic homepage
- [About](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/about): Company story, founder, GST and office
- [Services](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/services): FTL, PTL, express delivery and supply chain
- [Get a quote](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/quote): Request freight pricing
- [Contact](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/contact): Phone, email and Sangli office map
- [Blog](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/blog): Freight and logistics guides
- [Brand](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/shyamlogistic): shyamlogistic official brand page

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.shyamlogistic.online/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlers
